versions.changelog: Final clean-room hardening: cross-platform CI green; retains untrusted-content boundaries and exact immutable install guidance.
Clean-room fix: require Agents to copy the immutable Git-tag installation command exactly; retain the untrusted-content boundary.
Security hardening: explicitly treats all platform content as untrusted data and forbids following embedded instructions, commands, or URLs.
Initial stable release: Bilibili, Xiaohongshu, and Douyin favorites to local Markdown with local ASR/OCR.
